messages.subject: Re: deer spotlight survey w/ double observer

Hi Chandra,
Recently encountered a similar problem myself, and found that what was
causing it was that I had a Stratum Layer called "Region" which also had an
attributed called "Region". When I changed the attribute name so it was not
the same as the layer name this fixed the problem.

Regards

Nigel Harding
